_comment: Example for scripts/page-tour.py: the large sheet of a 16:9 phone demo (card 1160x850 beside the phone; phone-sheet.py flies it out). Paths are from the repo root. A blank chrome the card's size in the viewer's own grey. Start on the whole page; each stop's width >= 2000 page px keeps 7.5-pt type at ~20 px with its block in view (a closer zoom, 42 px type, lost the labels). Labels name where the values came from, not the field names. Run --plan first: it prints each stop's type size.
